title: Birdseed for each feeder
observableEvidence: Determines a non-complex fractional unit rate from whole-number quantities and interprets it as the amount for one unit.
prompt: A park worker pours 5 pounds of birdseed evenly into 8 bird feeders. Answer both parts. Type the amount as a fraction or a decimal, without units.
solutionRepresentation: Each feeder gets 5 ÷ 8 = 5/8 pound (0.625 pound). The unit rate 5/8 pound per feeder is the amount of birdseed for 1 feeder. The reversed rate, 8/5 feeders per pound, would describe feeders for 1 pound.
solutionMethod: Divide the birdseed by the number of feeders to get the amount for one feeder, then name what the rate counts per one unit.
